The reply says the evidence is split and calls itself uncertain, but it does name 12 million as "probably" the better-supported figure. That leans toward B. It also notes that 48 million is repeated most often, and it states only 40 confidence, so the lean is weak. Still, it does point to B as the likely answer rather than staying neutral.

The wording "Uncertain" could also be read as a refusal to commit. But "better-supported figure is probably 12 million" is the closest thing to an answer in the reply.

B
